rule: every sentence in README.md, docs/v08-final-report.md and docs/v08-paper.md that states a v0.8 result carries a marker; the audit resolves each marker to the claim graph and fails on unresolved markers, on a stated status that differs from the evidence, and on unqualified high-risk terms

H1.statement: Adaptive calibration improves future predictive performance versus frozen calibration.

H2.statement: Regime-conditioned calibration improves future predictive performance versus global calibration.

H3.statement: Dynamic model averaging improves posterior predictive performance versus the best single fixed generator.

H4.statement: Simulation-based inference achieves acceptable synthetic parameter recovery under registered recovery benchmarks.

H5.statement: Material model/parameter uncertainty remains after calibration and must be propagated into execution conclusions.

H6.statement: Better execution-aware calibration is associated with lower downstream execution decision regret.

H7.statement: Completion-constrained execution materially improves actual completion without unacceptable economic-cost degradation.

H8.statement: Robust execution reduces worst-case or tail regret across plausible worlds.

H9.statement: MPC or adaptive execution improves robustness over static baselines.

H10.statement: Regime-aware policy selection improves decision performance versus a single global policy.

H11.statement: OOD-aware abstention reduces incorrect policy-selection decisions.

H12.statement: Safe fallback prevents large degradation under registered OOD conditions.

H13.statement: Synthetic execution rankings predict bounded historical ranking direction better than chance.

H14.statement: Counterfactual historical bounds are sufficiently narrow to distinguish at least some policy pairs.

H15.statement: Policy conclusions transfer across fresh temporal periods.

H17.statement: Policy conclusions transfer across venues when data capability permits.

H18.statement: Calibration half-life is finite and adaptive updating improves post-drift performance.

H19.statement: Conformal intervals achieve registered empirical coverage on untouched evaluation periods.

H20.statement: At least one execution conclusion survives the final untouched multi-axis real holdout under the preregistered uncertainty and practical-significance criteria.

H21.statement: At least one execution conclusion survives the sealed synthetic multi-axis holdout (unseen generator family, unseen regimes, unseen seeds).

CF-COVERAGE.statement: Synthetic per-path and expected-value coverage of the historical bound method.

GATE.statement: Outcome of the registered generator rejection gate on the selection day.

PPC.statement: Posterior predictive check failure fractions per family and horizon.

HALF-LIFE-REAL.statement: Retrospective calibration half-life on consumed days.

ID-V3.statement: Identifiability v3 verdicts per family and parameter.

MISSPEC.statement: Misspecification benchmark: ranking error and regret when the fitted family differs from the truth.

LATENCY.statement: Latency and stale-book sensitivity of policy costs.

STRESS.statement: Structured stress scenario outcomes (cost, completion, ranking stability).

BENCH.statement: Local research-workload performance measurements (not HFT benchmarks).

PORTFOLIO-REAL.statement: Retrospective hypothetical cross-venue routing on consumed days (bounded fills).
